about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Fourth Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech You, merciful God, that we may treat Your holy things, with which we are ceaselessly filled, with sincere devotion, and ever receive them with a faithful mind. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: we may treat with sincere devotion
who lives and reigns with You
